cover_letter:
Dear ACENSI Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Content Migration Specialist position for your client in Brussels. With a foundation in digital marketing, web design, and a keen eye for detail, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to the migration and implementation of content into your client’s new CMS, ensuring a smooth and successful website launch.

My experience at Episto as a Junior Digital Marketer has provided me with practical skills in content management. I regularly build and maintain client websites using WordPress, which includes comprehensive content uploads, page updates, and editorial publishing. This hands-on experience has honed my understanding of content workflows and the practicalities of managing web content, making me adept at adapting to new CMS platforms, such as SiteCore, with a quick learning curve.

Beyond content implementation, my background in SEO and GEO has equipped me with a deep appreciation for content structure, quality, and metadata. On my personal project, mirook.com, I meticulously designed the full site structure, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), and conducted technical SEO/GEO audits. This work directly reflects the mission tasks of structuring and formatting content, reviewing its quality and consistency, and ensuring correct use of metadata and page structure for optimal digital presence. My ability to manage these intricate tasks from conception to completion also demonstrates strong organizational skills and a pragmatic approach.

I am proficient in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, with ongoing efforts to further improve my language skills, aligning with your bilingual environment requirement. While my current role is remote, I am available and eager to work on-site in Brussels. I am accustomed to working collaboratively, ensuring deadlines are met, and identifying potential risks proactively, drawing from my experience in managing client projects and content delivery schedules.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to bring my skills to ACENSI and contribute to your client's digital communication initiatives. I look forward to discussing how my experience can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
